citation.short_label: NYC §22-1201 et seq. (Biometric Identifier Information Law)

regulator.primary_agency_name: NYC Department of Consumer and Worker Protection

notes: NYC ordinance — requires conspicuous signage at entrances of commercial establishments collecting biometric identifier information + prohibits sale / transfer. Private right of action with $500 statutory damages per non-willful violation. NYC-specific (not statewide NY).
